interpretation.app_causality: No application defect is proved by these timing/outcome/host observations. Task alert code and exercised harness files are unchanged between refs; different queue/interleaving may still affect their real wall-time tails.
interpretation.confirmed_protocol_issue: Independent paced_lane monotonic epochs allow same nominal fingerprint to offer materially different persistent service phases; export-to-governance skew differs by about303ms and observed contention/outcome populations differ. Source has no shared epoch/barrier.
interpretation.controlled_next_experiment: A bounded five-lane ready barrier and one common monotonic epoch require a new arrival contract/fingerprint and a frozen baseline harness update. Preserve intervals, phases, closed-loop no-catchup, duration, datasets, budgets,thresholds and worker limits. After regression controls, use an explicitly approved same-source diagnostic counterfactual first if needed to assess remaining dispersion; do not repeatedly sample until green.
interpretation.export_scope: Overall export p95 improves but succeeded p95 regresses, with9 baseline safe policy-conflicts excluded. Explicit per-operation outcomes are absent; transaction-sequence attribution is owned by backend reviewer and must remain a corroborating proxy.
interpretation.host_scope: No sampled steal or cgroup throttle increments; sampled CPU pressure and involuntary context switches are positive. Broader-runner counters and means cannot rule out transient host contention or establish causal noise.
interpretation.observer_lane_scope: Recorded lane.start_ns is evaluated before Recorder.add obtains its short RLock; Recorder.lane calls original paced_lane after that add, with no recorder/global lock retained across the workload. First-export observer start follows entry by27.371/27.802microseconds. Registered observer callback maxima are14.649/16.863ms, not a directly recorded lane-wrapper duration. Indirect instrument-induced scheduling perturbation is not excluded by these observations.
interpretation.release_status: Diagnostic comparator remains failed. Earlier uninstrumented failures are retained; one diagnostic pair neither clears them nor establishes run-to-run variance.
